title: Reset each transform mode on its own, with a dot on a changed mode
goal: Let a person undo one kind of change without losing the others, as the user approved on 2026-11-01: right-clicking a mode on the selection chip offers Reset Size, Reset Skew & distort, Reset 3D and Reset All (a mode with nothing to reset greyed), the same rows sit under Layer > Transform, and a mode that has been changed shows a small blue dot on its chip button.
notes: Slice (4) of the-reworked-selection-ships-cleaner-grips-a-tag. The double-click on the knob already turns back to 0 degrees (CanvasSelectionGrips.selectionGripMouseDown). A menu command needs to reach the canvas's transformMode (it lives on CanvasNSView, reset to Size when the pick changes). Existing Layer > Reset 3D Rotation (EditorCommands, next-turn-in-depth) should fold into Reset 3D. Prototype: openReset / resetStage / changed() in selection-transform.html.
acceptance: Right-click on a chip button opens Reset Size, Reset Skew & distort, Reset 3D and Reset All, unchanged modes greyed; each is one undo step
Layer > Transform holds Turn in 3D (enters 3D mode), Skew, Distort, Keystone and the four resets, each with its shortcut where one exists
A changed mode shows a small blue dot on its chip button (white on the picked one); Reset Size returns the picture's own size and no turn about the same middle
A walk at Next defaults right-clicks the chip by the pointer and resets each mode

log.note: Adversarial pass: a Photoshop user resets with Edit > Transform or Esc; here the reset is on the chip's right click and in Edit > Transform. Risks: a picture's own size (pixels) vs the size it landed at (a scaled-down paste reads changed from the start; asked in the audit); shapes and text have no own size (only the turn counts); keys would put a reset straight back, so a reset takes its mode's keys, as Reset 3D Rotation always did.

Chose Edit > Transform over the acceptance's Layer > Transform for Turn in 3D and the resets because the app's one Transform submenu already lives in Edit (Photoshop's place), decided when Skew/Distort landed; two Transform submenus would split one job. Chose 'Reset Skew & Distort' over the mock's 'Reset Skew & distort' because every menu row is Title Case (UX-PATTERNS §7, enforced by MenuRowsAreTitleCaseTests). Chose to leave flips out of every reset: a flip is not a size, shape or depth change.

Pictures looked at: 2-three-dots (blue dots on Size and Skew & distort, white dot on the picked 3D button, matching the prototype close-up), chip-menu (the Mac's own menu at the chip, Reset 3D live, Size and Skew & Distort grey, divider, Reset All), 3-size-reset (picture upright at its own size, skew and tip kept, only the Size dot gone, tag 'Reset Size'), side-by-side with selection-transform.html. Left rough, no task: the chip's Skew & distort icon lacks the prototype's corner dots (from slice 2, a looks nit); walk 'wait' returns early on an idle app, so a clock needs onTheClock: true (documented already).

Shipped in bf2b5663 (Next, at defaults). Right-click a chip button: Reset Size, Reset Skew & Distort, Reset 3D, Reset All, greyed when unchanged, one undo step each, the tag says the reset. A changed mode wears a dot (white on the picked button). Reset Size returns a picture's own pixel size, upright, same middle. Edit > Transform gains Turn in 3D and the four resets (Edit, not Layer: the app's one Transform submenu, see log); Layer > Reset 3D Rotation folds into Reset 3D. Verified: 14 new core tests first, full Scripts/test.sh green; reset-each-transform-mode-walk (pointer right-clicks the chip, resets each mode) and transform-resets-from-the-menu-walk green at Next defaults with real captures; neighbouring walks (flip, keystone, skew, selection-grips, perspective-pill) green; audit 2026-11-01-transform-resets.json with a side-by-side against the prototype.
